timing: Post-hoc robustness plan fixed before calculating new sensitivity results; B11 points and six unadjusted 20k intervals are already known; not prospective preregistration
purpose: Assess multiplicity, grade-specific uncertainty and dependence on patient/fold composition without searching for a favorable result
contrast: full R11 minus natural CORAL with the same DeiT and selected fusion

family.scope: This ten-outcome sensitivity family only; does not adjust all earlier 192 paper intervals or undo post-hoc development

bootstrap.unit: patient retaining every ROI and duplicate patient multiplicities
bootstrap.reason_for_budget: Tail resolution of multiplicity sensitivity, not additional independent observations

required_checks: same SHA-anchored A6 predictions and selection freeze as B11
exact pooled and original fold-point reproduction
first 20000 core-metric bootstrap intervals reproduce B11 without replacing them
independent sklearn/raw-grade checks on the first eight actual patient resamples
weighted pooled metrics checked against sklearn sample_weight
influence_checks: all 468 leave-one-patient-out pooled six-metric differences; aggregate min/max and maximum point change only, no patient identifiers
all five leave-one-original-outer-fold-out pooled differences, descriptive only
six pooled metrics with each patient contributing total weight one, descriptive alternate estimand only
interpretation: Frozen-prediction internal retrospective sensitivity, not a new validation cohort
No retraining for deletion checks; not leave-one-out cross-validation
Equal-patient weighting is not the mean of individual patient kappas
Bootstrap intervals and Bonferroni-type coverage remain approximate
Report all ten outcomes and all five folds regardless of direction
Do not select models, weights, thresholds or outcomes using sensitivity results
